rule: A skater with 70+ points, 25+ goals or 60+ assists last regular season is listed in that category when his drought reaches either the tier bar from last season's total (points 100+ -> 3, 85-99 -> 4, 70-84 -> 5; goals 40+ -> 5, 25-39 -> 10; assists 60+ -> 3) or, for points and assists, the surprise bar from his own prior-season hit rate p, the smallest n with (1 - p)^n <= 0.05; the wager is the over 0.5.
